site_description: Membership of Mementomori ry, the non-profit behind mementomori.social
home_intro_1: Mementomori ry is a registered non-profit in Finland. It runs and funds the
home_intro_2: social media platform, keeping it independent and member-supported.
membership_intro: Membership funds the platform and gives you a say in how the association is run. Using mementomori.social stays free for everyone, member or not. The larger fee does not buy more influence: voting rights belong to regular members.
tier_member_sub: The standard membership for people who want to support our cause.
tier_patron_sub: The larger membership for organisations and generous individuals.
benefit_vote: Right to vote at the association meeting
benefit_speak: Right to attend and speak at the association meeting
benefit_matrix: Access to the members' channel on Matrix
benefit_feeling: A nice feeling you are supporting a good cause
fees_note: Fees are fixed and set by the association meeting. The monthly option is an instalment of the annual fee. Joining fee is 0 €, and membership is approved by the board.
money_costs: Running the mementomori.social infrastructure, websites and social media service costs {monthly} € a month, about {annual} € a year.
join_intro: The board reviews every application. Membership begins when the board approves it, and if an application is not approved, any fee already paid is refunded in full.
choice_masto_desc: Verify your account first. Your name gets prefilled, your avatar shows on the member list, and you sign in with Mastodon from then on. No password needed.
choice_form_title: I don't want to link an account
choice_form_desc: Fill in the application form and sign in with an email address and password. You can still link a Mastodon account later on the dashboard.
verified_as: Verified as @{acct} on mementomori.social. Finish the application below, no password needed.
municipality_note: Required by the Finnish Associations Act for the member register.
email_masto_note: Mastodon does not share your email address, and the association needs one for official communication.
option_member_rest: {year} €/year or {month} €/month. Right to vote at the association meeting.
option_patron_rest: {year} €/year or {month} €/month. For organisations and for anyone who wants to contribute more. Attendance and speaking rights, no vote.
consent_label: Show my name on the member list. The list is not public: only signed-in, approved members can see it. Optional.
join_footer: The board reviews every application. If it is not approved, any fee already paid is refunded in full.
err_name_municipality_required: Full name and home municipality are required.
login_hint: Mastodon sign-in works once you have linked your mementomori.social account on the dashboard. New here?
masto_signin_note: You can also sign in with Mastodon from now on.
masto_link_note: Optional. Verifies your handle and shows your avatar on the member list.
payments_none: No payments recorded yet. Payment instructions arrive by email once the board has approved your application.
costs_monthly_note: Running the mementomori.social infrastructure, websites and social media service costs {monthly} € a month.
members_note: Only members who have opted in are listed here. The full member register is maintained by the board as required by the Finnish Associations Act.
members_empty: No members have opted into the list yet.
pay_redirect_note: Payment opens in Stripe Checkout. The fee is fixed.
paid_thanks: Payment completed. It shows up in the list within a minute or two.
